names.display_en: The Last Sovereign of Later Liang

summary: 太祖第三子；凤历元年诛兄友珪即位；在位与李存勖争河北，梁势渐蹙；龙德三年唐军入汴，末帝命皇甫麟杀己，后梁亡。
summary_en: Third son of Taizu; in the 1st year of Fengli he slew his brother Yougui and took the throne; through his reign he contended with Li Cunxu for Hebei as Liang's strength ebbed; in the 3rd year of Longde the Tang army entered Kaifeng, and the Last Sovereign had Huangfu Lin kill him — Later Liang was no more.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载无形貌描写。画像宜表现守成不能之君之态，衣冠从五代初制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary_en: Third son of Taizu, first named Youzhen.

timeline.title: 诛友珪即位
timeline.summary: 均王友贞诛友珪，即帝位，复称乾化。
timeline.summary_en: The Prince of Jun, Youzhen, slew Yougui, took the throne, and restored the era Qianhua.

timeline.title: 河北争夺
timeline.summary: 与李存勖争魏博、河北，梁势渐蹙。
timeline.summary_en: He contended with Li Cunxu for Weibo and Hebei as Liang's strength ebbed.

timeline.title: 改元等
timeline.summary_en: His reign changed eras often; the government was unsteady.

timeline.title: 梁亡
timeline.summary: 唐军入汴，末帝命皇甫麟杀己，后梁亡。
timeline.summary_en: The Tang army entered Kaifeng; the Last Sovereign had Huangfu Lin kill him, and Later Liang was no more.

timeline.title: 末帝总评
timeline.summary: 不能制将帅，终亡于沙陀。
timeline.summary_en: He could not control his generals, and fell to the Shatuo at last.

relations.note: 乾化二年太祖被弑，诛友珪即位
relations.note_en: In the 2nd year of Qianhua Taizu is assassinated; he executes Yougui and takes the throne

relations.note: 龙德三年唐军入汴，梁亡于后唐庄宗
relations.note_en: In the 3rd year of Longde, Later Tang forces enter Bian; Liang falls to Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang

bio_md:
# 后梁末帝 · 主要事迹

朱友贞，梁太祖第三子。乾化二年，太祖为友珪所弑，友珪自立；凤历元年，均王友贞与赵岩等密谋，联络禁军诛友珪，即帝位，复称乾化。末帝在位十年，为五代诸帝中在位最久者之一；然「性懦弱，不任军事」，河北之地，与晋王李存勖争夺连年——柏乡、杨刘诸战，梁军屡败，梁势渐蹙。

贞明、龙德年间，梁朝政事「政出多门」，段凝、赵岩等用事；龙德三年，李存勖称帝于魏州（后唐），亲率大军袭汴。末帝闻唐军将至，登建国楼，命皇甫麟杀己，「挥涕而受刃」，后梁亡，年三十六。

史评末帝：「不能制将帅，终亡于沙陀。」后梁自太祖受禅至末帝亡国，历二帝十七年——五代之最短者之一。梁之亡，亡于太祖之暴政与末帝之懦弱；而李存勖之兴，则开沙陀三朝（后唐、后晋、后汉）之局。

> 参考：点校本《旧五代史》卷008-010《梁末帝纪》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Zhu Youzhen, third son of the Liang Taizu. In the 2nd year of Qianhua Taizu was slain by Yougui, who took the throne; in the 1st year of Fengli the Prince of Jun, Youzhen, plotting with Zhao Yan and the rest, drew in the imperial guards, slew Yougui, and took the throne, restoring the era Qianhua. Ten years he reigned — among the longest of the Five Dynasties; but "weak and timid, no hand for war," he contended year after year with the King of Jin, Li Cunxu, for Hebei — at Baima, Yangliu, and the rest the Liang armies were beaten again and again, and Liang's strength ebbed.

In the Zhenming and Longde years "the government came from many mouths," Duan Ning and Zhao Yan in power; in the 3rd year of Longde Li Cunxu took the throne at Weizhou (Later Tang) and rode at once against Kaifeng. Learning the Tang army was at hand, the Last Sovereign climbed the Jianguo Tower, had Huangfu Lin kill him — "weeping, he received the blade" — and Later Liang was no more, aged thirty-six.

The histories say: "he could not control his generals, and fell to the Shatuo at last." From Taizu's abdication to the Last Sovereign's fall, two emperors and seventeen years — one of the briefest of the Five Dynasties. Liang fell to Taizu's tyranny and the Last Sovereign's weakness; and the rise of Li Cunxu opened the three Shatuo dynasties — Later Tang, Later Jin, Later Han.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Jiu Wudaishi*, ch. 8–10 ("Annals of the Liang Last Sovereign").
